AltovizAPIKeyCredential.title: Altoviz API Key
AltovizAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In Altoviz, open Settings, then API access, create a key and paste it here. NoClick sends it in the X-API-KEY header to api.altoviz.com. The connection check reads your customers.
